NEET Exam Irregularities Spark Protests and Parliamentary Debate

Allegations of corruption and paper leaks surrounding the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) examination have led to protests and discussions in Parliament. Opposition MPs paid tribute to students who died by suicide, while professors suggested the centralized examination model contributes to the problem. The government has stated its readiness for a parliamentary discussion on paper leaks and has been asked by the Supreme Court to implement permanent reforms. Protesters have demanded answers, with some coverage noting police action under scrutiny.
